method: Manual native-coordinate palace polygons traced from only the actual K3/v2 photograph; Pillow rasterization without resampling or antialiasing. White denotes visible palace roofs and facades; black denotes everything else.
blindness: No source renders, target/reference masks, camera files, prompts, previous images, or metrics were inspected for this trace.
included: Visible palace roofs and vertical faces, including all shadowed building faces.
excluded: Large open western court and statue, eastern enclosed court floor, two visible foreground court floor strips, city beyond, river, roads, trees and surroundings.

uncertainEdges.detail: Fine distant roof ornaments, pinnacles and building ground contact have about 1-4 pixel uncertainty.
Eastern oblique wing roof edge, ornaments and some partial background occlusions have about 2-5 pixel uncertainty.
Eastern court ground contact and southern roof projection traced manually; about 2-4 pixel uncertainty; shaded vertical walls retained.
Two foreground court floors are partly shadowed/roof-occluded. Their floor-versus-facade contact has about 3-5 pixel uncertainty.
Foreground small roof decorations, local tree overlap and facade foot have about 1-5 pixel uncertainty.
